title: Historical V3 black screen and delayed first paint
statement: The earlier V3 preview could render a black screen or delay the shell; the durable lesson is that the primary interface must render before optional/heavy modules.
symptom: V3 opened with black/blank screen or waited on dependencies before showing the usable shell.
root_cause: Recovered evidence identifies an initially truncated HTML build and later blocking fonts/icons/scripts/heavy modules as contributors in the historical preview.
resolution: Repair truncated HTML and prioritize the shell using defer/lazy loading, non-blocking assets, feature loading and network timeouts.
prevention: Keep first paint independent from optional intelligence and remote services; do not block Home on heavy modules.
regression_test: Historical preview-v2 performance-shell/first-paint checks; on current main use the relevant performance/PWA/release gates when changing startup behavior.

title: Historical technical configurator returned zero OG configurations
statement: A technical configurator showed zero configurations when its OG data dependency had not been loaded before initialization.
symptom: Technical UI displayed 0 OG configurations despite configuration data existing.
root_cause: OG_DATA/core data was loaded after or independently from the configurator in the historical V3 flow.
resolution: Load the data dependency before the configurator and make dependency order explicit.
prevention: Technical modules must fail visibly on missing source data and tests must initialize the same dependency order as production.
regression_test: Technical/configuration tests must assert non-empty known fixture data only after the declared data dependency is loaded.

title: Historical close rate reached 48400 percent
statement: A historical close-rate calculation mixed sales from a broad CRM population with proposals from a narrower prospecting population, producing an impossible 48400 percent result.
root_cause: Numerator and denominator represented different commercial populations.
resolution: Attribute sales/proposals to the same filtered universe and constrain the semantic rate to a logically valid population.
prevention: Every conversion metric must document and test the population used by numerator and denominator.
regression_test: Metric tests must include unrelated historical sales and assert they do not affect a scoped prospecting close rate; close rate must not exceed 100% for the defined funnel.

title: Historical prospecting showed zero lists despite usable CRM views
statement: Prospecting became operationally empty when lists were treated as an isolated module instead of projections/collections over the CRM base.
symptom: Prospecting UI showed no useful lists while CRM already contained organized accounts/views.
root_cause: List UX was separated from the canonical CRM source and did not expose existing smart views as work sources.
resolution: Expose CRM views as sources for operational lists without duplicating companies.
prevention: Lists are collections over canonical CRM identity; never create a second company store to make a prospecting list.
regression_test: CRM/list integration tests should assert one company can appear in multiple operational lists without duplicating its canonical identity.

title: Silent revision conflict could overwrite local or remote work
statement: Revision conflicts require preserved local/remote state and explicit review; silent merge/resend is prohibited.
symptom: A stale client could conflict with newer server state and a naive merge/retry path risked hiding which work won.
root_cause: Treating optimistic-concurrency conflict as a retry/merge detail rather than a business-data review boundary.
resolution: Package 04R established revision-authoritative conflict handling, preserved local/remote comparison, durable auth-safe outbox and foreground reviewed delivery.
prevention: Never force-merge or auto-resend divergent commercial state; preserve both sides and require explicit resolution.
regression_test: npm run og:sync:conflict:test && npm run og:sync:conflict:ui:test && npm run og:sync:bridge:test

title: Excel repaired generated workbook structures
statement: A historical generated workbook opened with Excel recovery that removed an AutoFilter/table and a worksheet formula; the exact original serialization defect is not conclusively proven by recovered evidence.
symptom: Excel recovery log reported removed AutoFilter/table features and a removed formula.
root_cause: Not conclusively established. Recovered evidence supports a workbook-structure/compatibility problem, not a precise single serializer defect.
resolution: Current architecture isolates legacy XLSX handling and adds canonical template/import/export/builder tests; the specific historical repaired workbook has not been re-certified here.
prevention: Preserve canonical templates, formulas and manual fields; test generated workbooks structurally and perform a real Excel smoke test before declaring high-stakes exports certified.
regression_test: npm run og:spreadsheet:test && npm run og:spreadsheet-export:test && npm run og:spreadsheet-xlsx-builder:test; manual Excel open/repair-log check remains required for certification.

title: Call Intelligence real validation exposed audio and metric contract defects
statement: Real Call Intelligence validation required signed audio uploads to use raw binary, truck quantities to be recognized correctly, duplicate objection inflation to be prevented and synthetic TEST sessions to be excluded from production dashboards.
symptom: Real validation found upload/recognition/aggregation behavior that differed from the intended Call Intelligence contract.
root_cause: Integration assumptions were too permissive around signed upload body format, extraction normalization and metric inclusion.
resolution: Commit 39be4d18 hardened binary upload, quantity extraction, objection deduplication and production metric filtering.
prevention: Exercise Call Intelligence with real contract-shaped audio/transcript inputs and keep synthetic sessions explicitly segregated from production analytics.
regression_test: npm run og:call-intelligence:test plus the opt-in production runtime self-test when live validation is authorized.

title: Embedded faster-whisper fallback missed runtime dependency
statement: The embedded local faster-whisper fallback required an explicit runtime dependency that was missing from the first deployment path.
symptom: Local Whisper fallback could not complete its model download/runtime path reliably because a required Python dependency was absent.
root_cause: Runtime dependency contract omitted requests for the faster-whisper download/runtime path.
resolution: Commit af5469eb added the missing dependency and f4c2b3c6 added an end-to-end production runtime self-test over signed private audio → local transcription → trusted ingestion.
prevention: Pin runtime dependencies and validate the actual hosted fallback path, not only unit contracts.
regression_test: npm run og:call-intelligence:test and scripts/whisper-runtime-self-test.mjs in the authorized hosted environment.

title: Supabase remote schema and Edge Functions exceed versioned repository state
statement: The live Supabase backend contains structural state that cannot currently be reconstructed from the Git repository alone.
symptom: Live Supabase inventory showed 25 applied migrations and 13 active Edge Functions while the repository contained only 4 migration files and source for 2 Edge Functions.
root_cause: Backend changes were applied remotely across earlier implementation cycles without all generated/applied migration SQL and deployed Edge Function source being backfilled into the canonical Git history.
resolution: Not yet resolved. Before further structural Supabase expansion, reconstruct/export the live schema and function inventory into reviewed Git history, preserving order, provenance and rollback notes rather than inventing migration history.
prevention: Every future database or Edge Function change must be versioned in the same implementation cycle before it is considered complete; live-only backend state is not a reproducible release.
regression_test: Pre-flight for Supabase structural work must compare live migration/function inventory with versioned `supabase/migrations/` and `supabase/functions/`; the Intelligence Compiler contract preserves this incident and anti-pattern until a dedicated reproducibility gate replaces the manual check.
